basic_details.job_title: HAL Visiting Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), Aircraft Division, Nasik, has invited applications for 1 (One) Visiting Consultant (Endocrinologist) at its Industrial Health Centre (IHC). Applications go by post, courier or by hand to the Chief Manager (HR), Ojhar Township Post Office, Nasik, and must be received by 28 November 2026. No application is accepted by email.

qualification.details: Educational qualification: MBBS, MD(Medicine) + DNB / DM (Endocrinologist). Experience: minimum 2 years post qualification experience. Age limit: upper age limit 65 years (as on date of Advt.). The notice prints no age relaxation. Qualifications must be from Indian Universities / Institutes recognized by appropriate statutory authorities, and registered with a State Medical Council under the National Medical Commission (NMC), formerly the Medical Council of India. Only regular / full-time qualifications count. Qualifications acquired through part time, correspondence, distance education or E-learning courses are not eligible. Only Indian Nationals will be considered. Visits: maximum 2 visits per month, minimum 2 hours per visit. Conveyance: maximum conveyance charges per visit (to and fro journey) are Rs. 18/- per kilometer, or as per the prevailing rules of the company. Tenure: the initial engagement is for 2 (Two) years. An extension may be considered based on the Visiting Consultant's performance and the requirement of the Division. Performance is assessed by the Head of the Hospital, to whom the Visiting Consultant reports. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms of the post.

content_sections.heading: HAL Visiting Consultant - Endocrinologist at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

Industrial Health Centre, HAL Aircraft Division, Ojhar, Nasik
Post, courier or by hand (no email applications)

content_sections.heading: About HAL
content_sections.text: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited is described in the notice as a Maharatna Central Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Defence, Govt. of India. The notice says HAL has 20 Divisions and 10 R&D Centers, spread across 7 States and 10 geographical locations. Its Aircraft Division at Ojhar, Nasik, has a full-fledged multi-specialty Industrial Health Centre, for which this engagement is advertised.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the duly filled-in application in the prescribed format on A4 size paper (as attached to the notice) by post, courier or by hand to this address: Chief Manager (HR), Hindustan Aeronautics Limited, Aircraft Division, Ojhar Township Post Office, Tal Niphad, Nasik – 422 207 Attach self-attested copies of the documents and certificates listed under Enclosures below. The last date for receiving applications, by post, courier or by hand, is 28 November 2026. No application will be accepted by email. The notice does not say what to write on the envelope. For queries about filling in the application, the notice gives the telephone number 02550-272545.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: MBBS, MD(Medicine) + DNB / DM (Endocrinologist). Experience: minimum 2 years post qualification experience. Age limit: upper age limit 65 years (as on date of Advt.). The notice prints no age relaxation. Qualifications must be from Indian Universities / Institutes recognized by appropriate statutory authorities, and registered with a State Medical Council under the National Medical Commission (NMC), formerly the Medical Council of India. Only regular / full-time qualifications count. Qualifications acquired through part time, correspondence, distance education or E-learning courses are not eligible. Only Indian Nationals will be considered. Visits: maximum 2 visits per month, minimum 2 hours per visit. Conveyance: maximum conveyance charges per visit (to and fro journey) are Rs. 18/- per kilometer, or as per the prevailing rules of the company. Tenure: the initial engagement is for 2 (Two) years. An extension may be considered based on the Visiting Consultant's performance and the requirement of the Division. Performance is assessed by the Head of the Hospital, to whom the Visiting Consultant reports. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms of the post.

content_sections.heading: HAL Visiting Consultant - Endocrinologist Job Description
content_sections.text: Job specification: consultation of endocrine ailments like Thyroid, Diabetes, Growth diseases, etc. Visit the IHC of HAL Nasik on suitable days, as per the requirements of the Division, to treat patients on intimation from the Chief of Medical Services (CoMS). The Visiting Consultant may be requested to attend emergencies at the IHC, HAL Nasik Division.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Proof of age (Matriculation Certificate / Birth Certificate) Educational Qualification certificates Marks secured in the qualifying examinations Post Qualification Experience Valid Registration to medical practice in India Other relevant documents (if any) All copies must be self-attested. Originals of the relevant certificates and documents must be produced at the interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview, which will be held at HAL Hospital, Ojhar Township. Final selection will be made on performance in the interview. The interview schedule, including exact timing, will be intimated to shortlisted candidates by email only. Candidates therefore need a valid email ID, and HAL is not responsible for bouncing of any email sent to candidates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in HAL Nasik Visiting Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: There is 1 (One) vacancy for Visiting Consultant - Endocrinologist at the Industrial Health Centre, HAL Aircraft Division, Nasik.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 28 November 2026, whether sent by post, courier or by hand.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the HAL Endocrinologist post?
faq.answer: The qualification is MBBS, MD(Medicine) + DNB / DM (Endocrinologist), with a minimum of 2 years post qualification experience and valid registration with a State Medical Council under NMC.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 65 years as on date of Advt.

faq.question: Q5. How much remuneration will the Visiting Consultant get?
faq.answer: The maximum remuneration is Rs. 3,500/- per visit, with a maximum of 2 visits per month. Conveyance is up to Rs. 18/- per kilometer or as per prevailing company rules.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the HAL Nasik post?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed A4 format, with self-attested documents, by post, courier or by hand to Chief Manager (HR), Hindustan Aeronautics Limited, Aircraft Division, Ojhar Township Post Office, Tal Niphad, Nasik – 422 207.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply by email?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no application will be accepted by email, although the interview schedule will be sent by email to shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are called for a personal interview at HAL Hospital, Ojhar Township, and final selection is based on interview performance.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job and how long is the engagement?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary, with an initial period of 2 years, and gives no right to regular employee status. Extension may be considered based on performance.

faq.question: Q10. Who can apply for this post?
faq.answer: Only Indian Nationals with regular / full-time qualifications from recognized Indian institutes can apply; distance, correspondence, part-time or E-learning qualifications are not eligible.
